blocks.text: Bohat si beemariyan (disorders) respiratory system par asar dal kar saans ke amal mein rukawat banti hain. Yeh halki aur khud theek ho jane wali beemariyon, jaise aam zukam (common cold), se le kar sinusitis, otitis media, pneumonia, pulmonary tuberculosis, emphysema aur COPD jaisi sakht beemariyon tak hoti hain.
Upper respiratory tract ke infections

Upper respiratory tract infections (URIs) naak, gale, sinuses aur larynx ko mutasir karte hain. Yeh saans ke chhote qatron (respiratory droplets, jaise khansi ya chheenk ke qatre) se aasani se ek insaan se doosre ko lag jate hain.
1. Sinusitis

Sinusitis sinuses ki andar ki tah (lining) ki sozish (inflammation) hai. Sinuses nasal cavity ke gird hawa se bhari chaar jodi jagahein hain: aankhon ke neeche, aankhon ke upar, aankhon ke beech aur aankhon ke peeche. Sinusitis acute (7 se 10 din rehne wali) ya chronic (12 hafton se zyada rehne wali) ho sakti hai. Zyada tar sinusitis virus se hoti hai; kuch bacteria se, aur kabhi kabhar fungi se bhi.

blocks.alt: Daen taraf mun kiye sar ka pehlu se manzar, naak aur aankhon ke gird chaar rangeen sinus groups ke saath: ek aankhon ke oopar maathe mein, ek aankhon ke peeche, ek aankhon aur naak ke beech, aur ek aankhon ke neeche gaal mein.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.10: Sinuses (textbook ki Figure 10.10 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Above eyes, Behind eyes, Between eyes and nose, Under eyes.

blocks.text: Alamaat (symptoms): bukhar, band naak, naak se peep jaisa maada, soonghne ki taqat khatam hona, chehre mein dard, aisa lagna ke balgham naak ke peeche se gale mein gir raha hai, aur sar dard jo jhukne par kabhi barh jata hai.

Ilaj (treatment): zyada tar cases virus se hote hain aur antibiotics ke baghair theek ho jate hain. Agar bacteria se ho to aam tor par antibiotics ya sulpha drugs di jati hain. Doctor nebulization (dawa ki bhaap saans se dena) bhi de sakta hai jo sinuses aur naak ki sozish kam karti aur jaldi theek hone mein madad deti hai. Chronic ya baar baar hone wali sinusitis mein naak ki surgery bhi ho sakti hai jis mein jaraseem (pathogens) aur mucus nikale jate hain.
2. Otitis media

Otitis media middle ear (darmiyani kaan) ki sozish hai. Yeh acute (achanak shuru) ya chronic (chhe hafton se zyada) ho sakti hai. Is ki aam wajah Eustachian tube (kaan ko gale se jodne wali nali) mein fluid ka jama hona hai jo middle ear se nikal nahi pata. Jab yeh fluid nahi nikalta to middle ear mein bacteria aur viruses barhne lagte hain aur otitis media ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: Kaan ki qash: bahari kaan aur kaan ki nali eardrum par khatm hoti hai; us ke peeche teen chhoti haddiyon wala middle ear soozish (inflammation) mein hai aur jazvi taur par mayah (fluid) se bhara hai; aage semicircular canals, cochlea aur nerve wala inner ear hai. Eustachian tube middle ear se neeche jati hai aur tang (narrowed) hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.11: Otitis media (textbook ki Figure 10.11 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: External ear, Middle ear, Internal ear, Inflammation and fluid accumulation in the middle ear, Eustachian tube (narrowed).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Eustachian tube middle ear ko gale se jodti hai aur fluid ko nikalne deti hai. Jab yeh tang ya band ho jaye to fluid middle ear mein jama ho jata hai aur infection se sozish hoti hai: yahi otitis media hai.
Alamaat: kaan mein shadeed dard, ek ya dono kaan kheenchna (bachon mein), bukhar, kaan se fluid behna, tawazun (balance) kharab hona aur sunne mein mushkil.
Ilaj: munh se khane wali aur kaan mein dalne wali dard ki dawaein, aur agar bacteria se ho to antibiotics.
Lower respiratory tract ke infections
Lower respiratory tract infections mein pneumonia, pulmonary tuberculosis, lung abscess (lung mein peep ki thaili) aur bronchitis shamil hain.
1. Pneumonia

Pneumonia saans ka ek acute (achanak hone wala) infection hai jo halki se le kar jaan lewa beemari tak bana sakta hai. Pneumonia mein ek ya dono lungs ke alveoli mein sozish hoti hai aur woh peep (pus) aur fluid se bhar jate hain. Is se saans lena dardnaak ho jata hai aur oxygen kam andar jati hai. Pneumonia aksar virus ya bacteria se hota hai. Duniya bhar mein bachon ki maut ki sab se badi infectious (lagne wali) wajah yahi hai.

blocks.title: Bachon mein pneumonia
blocks.text: 2017 mein pneumonia se paanch saal se kam umar ke 808 000 se zyada bachay faut hue; yeh paanch saal se kam umar ke bachon ki tamam amwat (deaths) ka 15% tha.

blocks.alt: Ek phephra jis ka nichla hissa gehra hai jahan pneumonia ka asar hai. Do bare kiye boxes: normal alveoli, patli deewar aur khali; aur pneumonia wale alveoli, moti soozi hui deewaron ke saath aur peep (pus) aur mayah se bhare hue.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.12: Pneumonia (textbook ki Figure 10.12 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Normal Alveoli, Alveoli with pneumonia, Alveoli, Inflammation in alveolar wall, Alveoli filled with pus and fluid, Part of the lung affected by pneumonia.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pneumonia mein alveoli mein hawa ki jagah peep aur fluid bhar jata hai, is liye oxygen khoon tak kam pohanchti hai aur saans lena mushkil hota hai.
Kai jaraseem pneumonia kar sakte hain: zyada tar bacteria (khaas tor par Streptococcus pneumoniae) ya viruses (jaise human rhinovirus), aur kabhi kabhar fungi.
Alamaat: balgham wali khansi, saans phoolna, seene mein dard, bukhar, jild ka neela padna, bhook kam lagna, dil ki tez dhadkan (high heart rate) aur thakan.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein “high heat rate” chhapa hai; yeh chhapai ki ghalti hai. Sahi “high heart rate” (dil ki tez dhadkan) hai.

Ilaj: bacteria wale pneumonia mein khaas antibiotics di jati hain. Bukhar aur dard kam karne ke liye analgesics (dard ki dawaein) bhi di jati hain. Vaccination (teeke) bachon aur badon dono ko kuch bacterial aur viral pneumonias se bachate hain.
2. Pulmonary tuberculosis (lungs ki TB)

Tuberculosis (TB) ek chronic (lambi chalne wali) infection hai jo bacteria Mycobacterium tuberculosis se hoti hai. Yeh jism ke kai hisson ko mutasir kar sakti hai magar aam tor par lungs ko karti hai. Lungs ki TB ko pulmonary tuberculosis kehte hain. Yeh bohat tezi se lagne wali (contagious) hai aur khansi ya chheenk se phailti hai. Bacteria lungs mein ja kar barhte hain aur lung ke tissue, alveoli samet, mein sozish aur nuqsan karte hain. Alveoli ke nuqsan se lung mein chhote khane (cavities) ya surakh ban sakte hain, jin se lungs theek kaam nahi kar pate. Aakhri marhale mein alveoli itne kharab ho jate hain ke lungs jism ko kaafi oxygen nahi de pate. Is halat ko respiratory failure kehte hain, jo medical emergency hai.

blocks.alt: Trachea aur dono phephre; baen phephre (tasveer mein daen) ke oopri hisse mein kai gehre surakh hain, yeh tuberculosis ke banaye hue cavities hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.13: TB se mutasir phephra (textbook ki Figure 10.13 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.text: Alamaat: khoon wali khansi, aksar shaam ko aane jane wala bukhar, raat ko paseena, wazan kam hona, anorexia (bhook khatam hona), depression (udaasi), kamzori, sookhi khansi, aur lungs ki pleura ki sozish se seene mein dard.
Ilaj: kai antibiotics ek saath lambe arse tak (9 mahine) baqaidgi se lena.
Lungs ki beemariyan (disorders)
Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) lungs ki ek aham beemari hai.
1. Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)

COPD lungs ki ek chronic inflammatory (lambi sozish wali) beemari hai. Is ki aam wajahein tambaku noshi (smoking), aur nuqsan deh pollutants (aaloodgi) aur chemicals ke dhuen mein lamba arsa rehna hain. Kuch thode logon mein genetic wajah (protein alpha-1 antitrypsin ki kami) se bhi COPD ho sakti hai, chahe woh smoking na karein ya aaloodgi mein na rahein.

blocks.alt: Chhote phephre jin ka ek hissa neeche bara kar ke dikhaya gaya: kati hui bronchiole ki andar ki tah moti aur soozi hui hai aur tang lumen mein mucus bhara hai; is ke sire par bare, band alveoli mein hawa phansi hui hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.14: COPD se mutasir phephra (textbook ki Figure 10.14 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Mucus, Inflamed lining of bronchiole, Trapped air, Enlarged blocked alveoli.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: COPD mein bronchiole ki sooji hui tah aur mucus rasta tang kar dete hain; saans nikalte waqt hawa poori bahar nahi nikalti aur alveoli mein phans jati hai, jis se woh phool jate hain.
Alamaat: musalsal balgham (sputum) wali khansi, saans phoolna, wheezing (saans ke saath seeti ki awaz), seene ki jakdan (chest tightness), thakan aur baar baar saans ki naliyon ke infections.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki list mein “chest” ke baad lafz chhoot gaya hai; alamat chest tightness (seene ki jakdan) hai, jaisa kitab ke chronic bronchitis wale box mein likha hai.

Ilaj: COPD ka mukammal ilaj nahi (incurable), magar dhuen, aaloodgi aur chemicals se bach kar is ka barhna sust kiya ja sakta hai. Doosre ilaj: bronchodilators (saans ki naliyan kholne wali dawaein), saans se li jane wali corticosteroids, pulmonary rehabilitation (saans ki warzish aur training) aur oxygen therapy. Kuch shadeed cases mein surgery, jaise lung transplant, par ghaur kiya ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Chronic bronchitis
blocks.text: Chronic bronchitis bhi COPD ki ek qisam hai. Is mein lungs ki bronchial naliyon mein sozish aur tangi hoti hai. Mucus zyada banta hai jo raste mazeed band kar ke saans mushkil kar deta hai. Kitab ke mutabiq yeh beemari teen mahine se do saal tak rehti hai. Yeh cigarette ke dhuen, hawa ki aaloodgi ya factory ki gard jaisi takleef deh cheezon mein lamba arsa rehne se hoti hai. Alamaat taqreeban COPD jaisi hain: wheezing, saans phoolna, seene ki jakdan aur baar baar infections. Smoking chhod kar ise control kiya ja sakta hai; doosre ilaj bronchodilators, pulmonary rehabilitation aur kuch cases mein oxygen therapy hain.
Emphysema

Emphysema COPD ki ek qisam hai. Is mein alveoli ki andar ki deewarein kharab ho kar aakhir phat jati hain. Is se bohat se chhote alveoli ki jagah ek badi khali jagah ban jati hai aur gas exchange ki surface area kam ho jati hai. Emphysema ki sab se badi wajah smoking hai. Hawa ki aaloodgi, gard ya chemicals ke dhuen mein lamba arsa rehna bhi wajah ban sakta hai. Alpha-1 antitrypsin protein ki genetic kami se bhi emphysema ho sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Ek phephra jis ke do hisse boxes mein bare kiye gaye: normal alveoli, angoor jaise guchhon mein bohat si chhoti thailiyan; aur damaged alveoli, chand bari hawai jagahen jin ki andar ki deewarein toot chuki hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.15: Emphysema (textbook ki Figure 10.15 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Deewarein tootne se bohat se chhote alveoli mil kar ek badi jagah ban jate hain, to gas exchange ki surface kam ho jati hai.
Alamaat: saans phoolna, khansi, wheezing, thakan aur seene ki jakdan.

Ilaj: smoking chhodna sab se zaroori qadam hai, kyunke smoking jari rahe to beemari tezi se barhti hai. Doosre ilaj: bronchodilators, saans se li jane wali steroids, oxygen therapy aur pulmonary rehabilitation.

blocks.prompt: Do mareezon ki saans phool rahi hai. Ek ke alveoli fluid se bhare hain; doosre ke alveoli ki deewarein toot kar badi khali jagahein ban gayi hain. Har ek ko kaun si beemari ho sakti hai, aur dono mein gas exchange kyun kharab hai?
blocks.explanation: Pehle ko pneumonia hai: alveoli mein peep aur fluid hawa aur capillaries ke beech moti rukawat ban jate hain aur alveoli mein hawa ki jagah kam ho jati hai, is liye kam oxygen diffuse hoti hai. Doosre ko emphysema (COPD ki qisam) hai: bohat se chhote alveoli mil kar ek badi jagah ban jate hain, diffusion ki kul surface area kam ho jati hai, is liye hawa pohanchne ke bawajood bohat kam oxygen khoon mein ja pati hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Upper tract ke infections qatron se phailte hain: sinusitis (aankhon ke neeche, upar, beech aur peeche ke sinuses ki sozish; zyada tar virus se) aur otitis media (Eustachian tube mein ruke fluid se middle ear ki sozish).

Lower tract ke infections: pneumonia (alveoli mein peep aur fluid; bacteria, viruses, kabhi fungi; bachon ki maut ki sab se badi infectious wajah) aur pulmonary tuberculosis (Mycobacterium tuberculosis, contagious, lung mein cavities, 9 mahine antibiotics).

COPD smoking, aaloodgi ya alpha-1 antitrypsin ki kami se lungs ki chronic sozish hai; mukammal ilaj nahi magar dhuen se bach kar sust ki ja sakti hai. Emphysema (phati alveoli ki deewarein) aur chronic bronchitis (tang, mucus bhari bronchial naliyan) is ki qismein hain.
